text:
Lydia K.: Hey team — quick request for launch: need a compact asset pack for the benchmark blog + webinar promo. Items: 1) landscape hero (1600x900) + square (1200x1200), 2) three sticker graphics (cost / latency / reliability), 3) small benchmark chart PNG + SVG, 4) one infographic for SDR one-pager. Can design take?
Tom S.: Yes. Do we have final copy for stickers? Also confirm export specs.
Lydia K.: Copy: 'Lower cost', 'p95 <50ms', 'Built-in fallbacks' (sentence case). Export: PNGs + SVG icons, GIF sparkline (3 frames) under 500kb.
Sam (CreativeOps): Got it. Brand: palette v3, include light/dark hero variants for social. Accessibility: AA contrast for overlaid text.
Priya M.: Legal note: performance claims need source link in Figma and be worded as 'typical p95' unless approved. legal-bot: please review before publish.
legal-bot: Automated: flagged. Attach benchmark methodology URL and evidence.
Tom S.: Will sketch hero + chart tonight. I'll post Figma link here once ready. Timeline ok? Lydia: when do you need first pass?
Lydia K.: First pass in 48 hours. We have a 2-hour review window with Growth on Friday.
Sam (CreativeOps): I'll reserve export slot Fri morning. Also will create alt text and short descriptions for accessibility.
Tom S.: Uploading draft Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/launch-draft/xyz
Priya M.: Note for SDR one-pager: include three quick lines on 'how to use stickers' and a small email HTML snippet.
Lydia K.: Perfect. If anything blocks, ping @Lydia. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
